text: Fictional BankAssist policy: Report a lost or stolen card through the secure banking app or contact support. This demo cannot freeze a card.
Fictional BankAssist policy: The Demo Basic account has a monthly maintenance fee of 4 demo credits. The Demo Student account has no monthly maintenance fee.
Fictional BankAssist policy: To dispute a transaction, contact support through the secure app. Never provide a password or full card number in this demo.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Address changes require authentication in the secure app. This assistant can explain the process but cannot change an address.
